producer.policy: Disposable direct subprocess capture; no runtime collector added. Source/output texts and digests are embedded.

proposedMaterial.grammar: JSON insignificant whitespace outside strings only; retain every original token, order, string spelling, field, null and numeric literal. Do not reserialize or normalize path/position data.
proposedMaterial.status: proposal only; public-filter admission, source spans and preservation tests not implemented
proposedMaterial.restriction: Never applies to nonzero captures, native context, warning output, empty JSON or silence. --exit-zero must exist in original argv.

receiptDefaults.boundary: stdout pipe; stderr redirected to same pipe before exec; read through EOF
receiptDefaults.environment: Inherited environment; RUFF_OUTPUT_FORMAT, RUFF_CONFIG, FORCE_COLOR and CLICOLOR_FORCE removed. No reporter override; --isolated and --no-cache explicit original argv.

expectedDefaults.golden: Same artifact as output; full byte-exact boundary
expectedDefaults.required: Entire output: messages, codes, file associations, positions, snippets, caret, help, fix edits/context, counts, warnings and diff. sourceBefore/sourceAfter are external evidence, never output replacement.
expectedDefaults.test: CAPTUREONLY; parser and public-filter tests deferred to lead
